title: Item Milestone Log custom preset
description: JSON Schema for Item Milestone Log custom presets (config/itemmilestonelog/presets/<id>.json and data/<namespace>/itemmilestonelog/presets/<id>.json). The preset ID comes from the file name, not from this document.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference used by editors (for example "./preset-schema.json" or a URL). The mod accepts and ignores this key.

items.description: Target items in their final order. Entries are item IDs, tag keys, or {item, count} objects.

includes.description: Preset IDs whose items are expanded before this preset's own items.

category.description: Free-form grouping label (stored up to 64 characters).

order.description: Sort order for the preset list (ascending, then preset ID).

version.description: Preset content version; used for the version-upgrade guidance flow.

requiredMods.description: Mod IDs that must all be loaded for this preset to be applied.

groups.description: Optional item groups, validated against the includes-expanded items.

nextPresets.description: Preset IDs automatically applied after this preset is completed.

unlockAfterHours.description: Playtime in hours after which this preset becomes eligible for auto-apply.

displayName.description: Either one string used for every language, or an object mapping language codes to strings.

oneOf.description: An item ID (namespace:path), a tag key (#namespace:path), or either with a #<count> suffix.

item.description: An item ID (namespace:path) or a tag key (#namespace:path).
